errors.evidence: The sentence incorrectly implies that for the question "Какво ще бъде основното възнаграждение за труд", the value for the "Рядко" category is 51.5%. According to the chart, the value for "Рядко" for that question is 38.4%. The value 51.5% corresponds to the "Рядко" category of the next question, "Предвижда ли се допълнително възнаграждение (бонуси)".

errors.text_span: Няма ясна последователност или подредба във височината на стълбовете между различните категории въпроси
errors.evidence: The chart consists of horizontal bars, which have length, not height. More importantly, since it is a 100% stacked bar chart, all bars have the same total length (representing 100%). The statement is misleading as it suggests the total size of the bars varies, when in fact it is the internal proportions of the segments that differ.
